landing.faq1Question: How do I apply for a tricycle franchise?
landing.faq1Answer:
To apply for a tricycle franchise, you have two options:

• Online Application: Register an account on our platform, complete the online application form with all required documents, and submit it for BPLO review. You'll be notified of the approval status through the system.

• Walk-in Application: You can also apply in person at our office where our staff will assist you with the application process.
landing.faq2Question: What documents are required for franchise application?
landing.faq2Answer:
Required documents include:
• Motor registration (OR/CR)
• Barangay clearance
• Cedula
• Driver's license
• Motor chassis stencil rubbing
• Operator/driver photos (1x1)

You can submit these documents in two ways:
- Online: Upload directly through the online form
- Walk-in: Submit physical copies at our office
landing.faq3Question: How long does the approval process take?
landing.faq3Answer: The approval process typically takes A week. First, BPLO reviews your application, then it's forwarded to the Sangguniang Bayan for final approval. You can track your application status in real-time through your dashboard.
landing.faq4Question: How does the QR code verification system work?
landing.faq4Answer: Once your franchise is approved, a unique QR code is generated for your tricycle. Passengers can scan this code to instantly verify your franchise status, view driver information, and confirm that your vehicle is legally registered and compliant.
landing.faq5Question: What if my application is disapproved?
landing.faq5Answer: If your application is disapproved, you'll receive a notification with the specific reason. You can then edit and resubmit your application with the necessary corrections through your operator dashboard. All your previous data will be prefilled for easy editing.
